display.purpose: Wordmark and every heading (h1, h2, home hero). The one heading face in the app; never used for labels, buttons, or body copy.

ui.purpose: Body copy, labels, buttons, nav, list descriptions. Default document font.

mono.purpose: Every textarea/input that holds or produces tool data (JSON, Base64, hashes, UUIDs, timestamps), plus the small route tag on each home row. Content in a code face, not a technical costume.

shadows.name: header-separation
shadows.purpose: Sticky app-shell header lift off the page; the hairline border alone is too close in value to the page background on a light surface.

shadows.name: row-raised
shadows.purpose: Home tool-row hover/focus-visible, paired with the background shift to white — the row reads as lifting off the page.

shadows.name: panel-raised
shadows.purpose: The .tool-panel card that holds each tool's controls.

motion.name: row-hover
motion.purpose: Home tool-row hover/focus-visible, paired with the chevron fade/slide (opacity + transform, 160ms ease-out).

motion.name: button-hover
motion.purpose: Primary button hover/active: fill brightens and lifts 1px (translateY(-1px)).

motion.name: field-focus
motion.purpose: Textarea/input/select focus; the focus-visible outline itself appears instantly, only the border color eases.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one button style in the app (Format / Run / Generate / Hash / Convert / Transform). Filled, self-contained contrast, disabled state at 45% opacity.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-6); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-hover); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Data Textarea
components.description: Every tool's input/output field. Recessed well (--bg fill) inside the white .tool-panel, monospace for the data it holds.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-textarea" rows="4" aria-label="Example input" placeholder="Paste here"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-textarea { width: 100%; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text-primary); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: var(--space-3); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--text-sm); transition: border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-textarea:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent-strong); outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Home Tool Row
components.description: Full-width linked row on the home tool list. No card, no border-left accent; hover/focus raises the row to white with a soft shadow and reveals an authored chevron.
components.html: JSON formatterPretty-print or minify JSON in your browser./tools/json-formatter
components.css: .ds-tool-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-4); padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-3); text-decoration: none; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: inherit; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, box-shadow 160ms ease-out; } .ds-tool-row__title { display: block; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--text-md); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-tool-row__description { display: block; font-size: var(--text-sm); color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: var(--space-1); } .ds-tool-row__path { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--text-xs); color: var(--text-tertiary); } .ds-tool-row__chevron { color: var(--accent-strong); opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-2px); transition: opacity 160ms ease-out, transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-tool-row:hover, .ds-tool-row:focus-visible { background-color: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); } .ds-tool-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tool-row:hover .ds-tool-row__chevron, .ds-tool-row:focus-visible .ds-tool-row__chevron { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }

components.name: Tool Panel
components.description: The raised white container that holds each tool's own controls, on the tool page.
components.css: .ds-tool-panel { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: var(--space-6); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04), 0 4px 16px -8px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); }

narrative.overview: GJB Toolbox is a small bench of hand tools you reach for mid-task, not a SaaS product with a home screen to check daily. The world is a workshop bench in daylight: light, cool steel-and-paper surfaces (brushed-aluminum grey, not cream), a warm brass/copper accent standing in for the metal fittings and hand tools themselves, and a soft two-tone gradient — warm light from one corner, cool shadow from the other — rather than a flat white void or a decorative pattern. Data (JSON, hashes, UUIDs, timestamps) is set in a real code/measurement face because it is code and data, not because monospace reads as technical.
keyCharacteristics: Light steel-and-paper surfaces, not cream, not a flat white void
One brass/copper accent, used only for primary actions, hover/current state, and focus
Two surfaces only (page grey, raised white) reused everywhere instead of a multi-step scale
One authored SVG chevron as the app's entire icon vocabulary, no unicode glyphs
Exactly three intentional micro-interactions; everything else is instant or static

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The brass accent is reserved for primary actions, current/hover state, and focus. It never decorates static content.

rules.name: The Authored Icon Rule
rules.body: Icons are hand-drawn single-stroke SVG in one consistent vocabulary. No unicode arrows, no emoji, standing in for an icon.

rules.name: The No-Toggle Rule
rules.body: One committed light system, applied everywhere. No dark/light toggle and no persisted theme preference — this app keeps zero client persistence by design.

rules.name: The Three-Motion Rule
rules.body: Row hover, button hover, and field focus are the only transitions in the system. No page-load choreography, no decorative motion.

dos: Do reuse the two surfaces (--bg, --surface) instead of inventing a third grey.
Do set data-bearing textarea/input content in the mono face; it is content, not decoration.
Do give every interactive control a positive, visible focus-visible outline (2-3px offset, never inside the control).
donts: Don't use purple/indigo tints, cream-paper + terracotta serif warmth, or a flat white void.
Don't add glowing neon edges or halos — shadows carry an offset and a soft blur, never a zero-offset colored glow.
Don't reach for a unicode glyph (arrows, braces, emoji) as a stand-in icon.
Don't add a card-grid homepage, a kicker/eyebrow label, or a colored border-left accent.
Don't add client-side persistence (localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB) for theme or any other preference.
